brief.text: Cascade Investment's $129,305,617 purchase in RSG stands far above all other activity, dwarfing every other transaction reported. Although listed under notable individual purchases, PMTS actually logged four separate buyers—led by a $11,287,500 transaction from Tricor Pmt25 Holdings alongside three board members totaling $649,989—forming an unlisted cluster. Among designated cluster buys, GME registered the highest total at $21,605,932 across three insiders, while CYBN and RLMD highlighted a shared concentration in pharmaceutical preparations totaling over $6.6 million.
